exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.
availability.purchase: Installing one is a single deterministic purchase costing exactly two units of its assigned specialized material.

effects.pellet_path: All five pellets spread and then curve inward to converge on a focal point.
effects.focal_point_location: centered on persistent mech facing at current maximum range

rules.text: All five pellets spread and then curve inward to converge on a focal point centered on persistent mech facing at current maximum range.
Each pellet deals 140% current Damage. A target at the focal point can take all five, for 63 rank-zero damage per attack.
Targets much closer than the focal point are likely to receive only part of the volley; the weapon does not rotate the focal point toward an enemy independently of mech facing.
This converts a close crowd fan into a precise medium-range execution weapon.
